Around 2 minutes 45 seconds.

tracks.tags: Uplifting modern gospel-soul meets anthemic pop, warm and triumphant with tears-of-joy energy. Midtempo around 76 BPM, rich Hammond organ, gospel piano, deep pocket drums, warm bass, and a full choir that swells in the choruses. Soulful, powerful male lead — tender and grateful in the verses, soaring and unrestrained in the chorus, answered by a stacked gospel choir. Opens intimate on piano and voice, builds by adding organ and drums, lifts into a full choir chorus, then a key-change final chorus with hand-claps and ad-libs before a warm resolving chord.
